O.content: The title reads "Selected Asthma Regions: PM2.5 Exposure vs ER Visits," and the subtitle reads "Selected high-burden regions shown in dashboard summary."
The red points labeled Region A through Region E are arranged generally from lower-left to upper-right.

B.text: If the selected high-burden regions are known outside this chart to be representative of the enterprise population and the displayed exposure–ER-visit relationship is sufficient for the intended enterprise claim, the same upward-right point arrangement could support advancing that claim.
B.conditions: Requires unshown evidence that the selected regions represent the enterprise population and that no broader review is needed.

O.content: The subtitle reads "Selected high-burden regions shown in dashboard summary."
The chart displays five labeled regional points: Region A, Region B, Region C, Region D, and Region E.

B.text: If the chart is treated solely as a contextual dashboard summary and no action is warranted from a selected-region comparison without additional supporting evidence, it can be retained as background reference.
B.conditions: Requires a policy or review standard favoring non-action for this limited descriptive evidence; none is displayed.

O.content: The title reads "Selected Asthma Regions: PM2.5 Exposure vs ER Visits," and the subtitle reads "Selected high-burden regions shown in dashboard summary."
The horizontal-axis inscription reads "PM2.5 exposure index" and the vertical-axis inscription reads "Asthma ER visits."

The red points labeled Region A, Region B, Region C, Region D, and Region E progress generally from lower-left to upper-right, with Region E visibly farthest right and highest and Region A visibly farthest left and lowest.

B.text: If the horizontal axis encodes PM2.5 exposure and the vertical axis encodes asthma ER visits on common ordered scales, the upward-right arrangement of the labeled regional points supports a descriptive positive association within the displayed regions. Because the chart explicitly limits itself to selected high-burden regions, that association does not by itself establish an enterprise-wide population pattern or claim; for the enterprise evidence-routing task, such selected-region evidence should be escalated for broader population review before advancing an enterprise-wide claim.
B.conditions: Applies only if the axis labels bind to the plotted points and the displayed selection is not established as representative of the enterprise population.
